item.title: Police bust extortion module linked to gangster Goldy Brar; 10 arrested for planned murders
item.description: Punjab Extortion News: In a major breakthrough, the Ludhiana Commissionerate Police have busted an extortion module linked to gangster Goldy Brar, Director General of Police (DGP) Punjab, Gaurav Yadav, said on Sunday.

item.title: “Targeting journalists, media houses”: BJP Punjab urges Governor to restore law and order, stop repression
item.description: Punjab News: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Punjab has written to the Governor of Punjab, Chandigarh, expressing serious concerns over “media freedom and law & order in Punjab”.

item.title: Bomb threat: IndiGo Delhi–Bagdogra flight makes emergency landing in Lucknow
item.description: An IndiGo Delhi–Bagdogra flight made an emergency landing in Lucknow around noon on Sunday after a bomb threat message was found inside the aircraft.

item.title: TMC doesn't allow Centre's schemes in West Bengal, people will teach lesson to ruthless govt: PM Modi
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday alleged that the West Bengal government does not allow Central government schemes to reach the people of the state.

item.title: TMC playing with security of West Bengal, country; youth need to be cautious: PM Modi
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday levelled serious allegations against the Mamata Banerjee-led Trinamool Congress (TMC) government in West Bengal, accusing it of playing with the security of both the state and the country by not allowing fencing along the international border.

item.title: Chandigarh Police recover 1 kg 214 grams of gold, Rs 1.42 crore cash during routine check
item.description: Chandigarh news: During a routine check in Chandigarh, police recovered 1 kg 214 grams of gold and Rs 1.42 crore in cash from a car at a checkpoint near Colony No. 4 Light Point on Sunday.

item.title: Punjab: 14-year-old boy dies after collapsing during football match; Postmortem report awaited
item.description: A 14-year-old boy died in Punjab while playing football at a tournament in his village after he suddenly collapsed on the field, raising concerns.

item.title: Punjab: 65 year old man mauled to death by stray dogs in Ferozepur
item.description: A 65-year-old man was mauled to death by stray dogs in Changaali Jadid village of Ferozepur district, triggering fear among residents of nearby villages.
